# Training curriculum

*Generated by `training/build.py`. Edit `training/src/*.json`, not this file.*

## Marketing track (60 min)

1. **Your role at PVV** (8 min)
2. **One goal, one audience** (10 min)
3. **Message and story** (10 min)
4. **Design a flyer people read** (12 min)
5. **Channels and Stanford promotion** (10 min)
6. **Measure and hand off** (10 min)

Linked resources:

- Read: [PVV constitution (AY 2025-26)](https://github.com/Eddyo-Spaghettio/PVV/blob/main/docs/constitution.md)
- Read: [Canva: A guide to nonprofit marketing, social media, and fundraising](https://www.canva.com/learn/your-guide-to-nonprofit-marketing-social-media-and-fundraising/)
- Explore: [Candid Learning course catalog (find the video on storytelling tips)](https://learning.candid.org/page/course-catalog)
- Explore: [Canva Design School: Canva Pro for Nonprofits](https://www.canva.com/design-school/courses/canva-pro-for-nonprofits/)
- Try: [WebAIM contrast checker](https://webaim.org/resources/contrastchecker/)
- Open: [90-day content calendar template (24 pre-planned posts)](https://github.com/Eddyo-Spaghettio/PVV/blob/main/templates/bridge-kit/90-day-calendar-template.csv)
- Read: [Haas Center: resources for student groups](https://haas.stanford.edu/resources/student)
- Try: [Create your first form in Google Forms](https://support.google.com/a/users/answer/9303071?hl=en)

## Financial track (60 min)

1. **Two doors of funding** (8 min)
2. **Find funders that fit** (10 min)
3. **Anatomy of a proposal** (10 min)
4. **Budgets funders trust** (12 min)
5. **Narrative and letter of inquiry** (10 min)
6. **Track, comply, and stay in scope** (10 min)

Linked resources:

- Read: [Haas Center: resources for student groups](https://haas.stanford.edu/resources/student)
- Try: [ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer](https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/)
- Explore: [Candid Learning course catalog (find the grantseeking kickoff video)](https://learning.candid.org/page/course-catalog)
- Read: [Candid: nonprofit grant writing tips and free proposal resources](https://candid.org/blogs/nonprofit-grant-writing-tips-free-proposal-resources-expert-how-tos/)
- Open: [Candid sample documents: real proposals, budgets, and letters](https://learning.candid.org/resources/sample-documents/)
- Watch: [Candid: What do funders look for in grant proposal budgets?](https://learning.candid.org/what-do-funders-look-for-in-grant-proposal-budgets/285820)
- Read: [Candid: examples of nonprofit budgets](https://learning.candid.org/nonprofit-budget-examples/275332)
- Open: [PVV grant budget template](https://github.com/Eddyo-Spaghettio/PVV/blob/main/training/templates/grant-budget-template.csv)
- Open: [PVV funding tracker template](https://github.com/Eddyo-Spaghettio/PVV/blob/main/training/templates/funding-tracker.csv)

## Technical track (60 min)

1. **Your role and discovery** (8 min)
2. **Build the Reach Page** (12 min)
3. **Forms and surveys** (10 min)
4. **Data and spreadsheets** (10 min)
5. **Accessibility and mobile** (10 min)
6. **Security, privacy, and handoff** (10 min)

Linked resources:

- Read: [Bridge Kit: what PVV has already built](https://github.com/Eddyo-Spaghettio/PVV/blob/main/bridge-kit/README.md)
- Read: [A real client page, defined as data (pilot Reach Page)](https://github.com/Eddyo-Spaghettio/PVV/blob/main/bridge-kit/data/clients/rosalie-rendu-center.json)
- Open: [Website launch checklist](https://github.com/Eddyo-Spaghettio/PVV/blob/main/training/templates/website-launch-checklist.csv)
- Try: [Create your first form in Google Forms](https://support.google.com/a/users/answer/9303071?hl=en)
- Read: [How to use Google Forms (including saving responses to a Sheet)](https://support.google.com/docs/answer/6281888?hl=en)
- Watch: [Section 508: how to use the WebAIM contrast checker](https://www.section508.gov/training/create/making-color-usage-accessible/webaim-contrast-checker/)
- Try: [WebAIM contrast checker](https://webaim.org/resources/contrastchecker/)
- Read: [W3C: accessibility principles](https://www.w3.org/WAI/fundamentals/accessibility-principles/)
- Read: [CISA: use strong passwords](https://www.cisa.gov/secure-our-world/use-strong-passwords)
- Read: [CISA: turn on multifactor authentication](https://www.cisa.gov/secure-our-world/turn-mfa)
